_doc: Prompt template for AI-generated characters. {placeholders} come from the asset's 'vars' in config/assets.json. The style and negative parts are appended to every prompt so all characters match GDD 10 and stay original.
prompt: Full-body stylised-realism 3D game character of an invented adult padel player, {age}, {build} athletic build, {hair}, wearing a plain {kit_colour} short-sleeve sports shirt, plain shorts and plain court shoes, standing in a T-pose, arms straight out, neutral expression, clean simplified shapes, game-ready, even lighting
negative: logo, text, letters, numbers, brand, emblem, badge, sponsor, watermark, celebrity, real person, likeness, racket, ball, weapon, extra limbs, base, pedestal
